We have two functions: court_records_search_cases and briefs_display_cases. We need to call court_records_search_cases twice: once for location "New York", year 2021, query "盜竊", limit 5; and again for location "San Francisco", same parameters. Then we will get lists of case IDs from each result. Then we combine them into one list of case IDs? The user says "display the first 5 relevant cases". That could mean overall 5 across both locations or 5 per location? It might mean overall 5 across both locations. But we can interpret as 5 per location? The phrase "前5個相關案件" could refer to the combined set. But it's ambiguous. Usually they'd want 5 per location? But they didn't specify per location. So we should return 5 total. But we might need to decide how to handle duplicates? We'll just combine results from both searches, then take the first 5 case IDs. Then call briefs_display_cases with those case IDs.
